steps.task: Open the extracted package and understand the edition
steps.evidence: README.md and START-HERE.md identify Free 3.0.0, one plugin, 25 roots, 16 nested cores, optional state, and the local-candidate boundary.

steps.task: Understand what may be redistributed and what CC BY-ND prohibits
steps.evidence: LICENSE.md, ATTRIBUTION.md, NOTICE.md, TRADEMARKS.md, PROVENANCE.md, and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md explain MIT software rights, CC BY-ND 4.0 authored-material terms, attribution, marks, provenance, and component custody.

steps.task: Detach a Claude-compatible skill without losing its rights record
steps.evidence: All 25 standalone folders and ZIPs carry nova-free-rights; TestForge, Agent Swarm, and career-pair component notices are included where applicable.
README -> START-HERE -> docs/INSTALL-CODEX.md; the codex marketplace root exists and exact marketplace add, plugin add, and plugin list commands are present.

steps.task: Confirm the documented Codex command surface
steps.evidence: codex-cli 0.144.5 exposes plugin management, marketplace add, plugin add, plugin list, and the documented JSON flags. No host catalog was mutated.

steps.task: Start a fresh task and invoke Nova
steps.evidence: The package supplies an invocation route, but no host installation or model invocation was authorized or executed.
Complete bundle, 25 standalone folders, and 25 deterministic standalone ZIPs are present and explained.

steps.task: Keep state optional or plan explicit initialization
steps.evidence: Ordinary use requires no estate; read-only status and plan-before-init prompts are documented; state and operations regressions passed.
Same plugin ID and replacement semantics are explicit; old package, configuration, and state preservation plus rollback are described without claiming automatic migration.

steps.task: Find troubleshooting, security, support, and rights boundaries
steps.evidence: Self-contained styled pages and maintained Markdown routes cover recovery, private security reporting, support, split licensing, and third-party custody.

steps.task: Follow only links shipped in the deployed docs artifact
steps.evidence: docs/check_site.py rejects existing targets outside docs; the focused regression and 11-page site check pass.

steps.task: Receive current documentation in the built package
steps.evidence: 24 source/package docs-tree files and 11 root customer documents are byte-identical; the package oracle checked 137 customer references.

steps.task: Capture the site at desktop and mobile dimensions
steps.evidence: Eleven desktop and one 390x844 overview PNG were freshly captured and hashed. Direct pixel review was blocked by the in-app browser security policy and was not performed.

conditions: Fresh-host installation, discovery, restart, and invocation were not observed.
Direct pixel-level visual inspection was blocked by the current environment.
Keyboard-only and screen-reader behavior were not exercised.

Publication was not authorized or performed.
evidence_boundary: A source and extracted-package walkthrough, local CLI surface check, static semantics, link boundary, byte parity, and render capture. It is not a direct visual, fresh-host, assistive-technology, publication, or customer-outcome acceptance run.
